subject: general
question: How does the poem illustrate the process of writing a literary composition?

options.text: By demonstrating that poems are generally composed in a single session, with a constant and uninterrupted flow of ideas
By implying that creativity is a systematic process and adheres to a standardized formula
By representing inspiration as being cut up into pieces, coming bit by bit, before a whole thought is formed
By drawing attention to the fact that poetic ideas arrive already shaped, with no work or time needed

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ***Option 3: By representing inspiration as being cut up into pieces, coming bit by bit, before a whole thought is formed.***

 
 
• According to the passage, the poem serves as a **"perfect illustration"** of how inspiration arrives. It emphasizes that **"any literary composition is produced in parts."**
